Self.Wiki: DLC ride jump (formerly Locked Mount Jump; the game's CSDlcRideJumpRegionIns). A sealable spiritspring: it only launches Torrent while its event flag is ON. It shows one SFX while active and another while sealed, and switches between them when the flag changes. Usually paired with a DLC Ride Jump-off at the descent.

JumpHeight.Wiki: Height the player will move upwards when activating this spiritspring.

SfxID.Wiki: SFX shown while the spiritspring is active. A negative value uses GameSystemCommonParam dlcRideJumpRegionDefaultSfxId (841070 in retail). Retail uses 806731 or -1.

EnableEventFlagID.Wiki: The spiritspring is active only while this event flag is ON. The game re-checks the flag every frame. 0 or -1: always active.

DisabledSfxID.Wiki: SFX shown while the spiritspring is sealed (flag OFF). A negative value uses GameSystemCommonParam dlcRideJumpRegionDefaultDisableSfxId (841071 in retail). Every retail region uses -1.
